name: quality gate
rules: Run the repository's documented quality gate using the host-appropriate, reproducible commands.
Do not skip, mute, weaken or reconfigure required verification to obtain a green result.
Report failures, missing tooling and unavailable optional checks explicitly.
verification: Identify the applicable test, lint, type, architecture and validation commands.
Record exact commands and outcomes and investigate every failure before completion.

provided_capabilities.description: Identify and structure the reproducible checks required by a quality gate
